meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭出符合约定的可渲染合成结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要编排多素材画面并需要一个稳定可复用的创作约定。
copy.tagline_en: Set up media scenes that follow clear timing and rendering rules.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build layered compositions and want stable, predictable rendering.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按规则把视频做成一个可渲染的 HTML 合成:元素用 data-* 标时间,class="clip" 片段入轨道,媒体播放归框架管理,并遵守确定性渲染限制;也涵盖 STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md 计划格式。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 HTML 做视频项目、讨论画面时序/轨道/子合成等结构,或要求先写 STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md 计划时,Claude 会启用这套构建规则。

say.text: 用 HTML 做一个 10 秒视频项目,含 3 个按时序播放的画面。
say.note: 会生成一个带时长的合成 HTML。

say.text: 先写 STORYBOARD.md 和 SCRIPT.md,再把这支视频做成合成。
say.note: 先出计划文件,再按计划搭 HTML 合成。

say.text: 帮我给现有合成加一个片段,从第 3 秒开始、放 2 秒。
say.note: 为新片段设好起始与时长,不动其他内容。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a video idea into a single renderable HTML composition: elements use data-* for timing, class="clip" clips go into tracks, media playback is framework-owned, and deterministic-render rules apply. It also covers STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build an HTML video composition, discusses timing/tracks/sub-compositions structure, or requests STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plans before writing composition HTML.

say_en.text: Make a 10-second HTML composition with 3 clips that play in sequence.
say_en.note: Produces an HTML composition with a set duration.

say_en.text: First write STORYBOARD.md and SCRIPT.md, then build this video as a composition.
say_en.note: Writes the plan files first, then builds the HTML.

say_en.text: Add a clip to my existing composition, starting at second 3 for 2 seconds.
say_en.note: Sets the new clip's start and duration without touching others.
